what: A few words in a sentence stay blank, and once the text crosses the line at 20% from the bottom of the screen, once — the box behind the word (the opposite face from the background) fills upward from its bottom edge in .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) (.45s late), and over it the word’s letters turn on .7s later in .25s. White boxes on a dark ink panel holding black words — the key terms stand out on their own like a stamp on a report

options.dur: Seconds for the box to fill up, default .35 — Brand contact page header .8
options.delay: Box delay (s), default .45 — brand contact head .4
options.step: Extra delay per word (seconds), default 0 — Brand contact heading .1 (center and last words .5 · .6)
options.--fx-mark-bg / --fx-mark-ink: Box and text colors (via css), default --kf-surface · --kf-ink
options.--fx-inset: Inner top and bottom padding of the box, default 0 — use 5% to make it thinner than the line height
options.--fx-pad: Box left and right margin, default 8px

use: We Design PrinciplesDepartment StrategyWork by bundling

from.where: index.html thought intro text · strategy model result section · message section (.s-strategy-model__highlight — a white box fills from below at .35s and the text follows .7s later)
